title: Plastic Packaging Tax: enquiries

Plastic Packaging Tax: enquiries
Call or write to HMRC to get help with Plastic Packaging Tax, including general enquiries and changing your details.
Online
Make an enquiry about environmental taxes 
Use this form to ask HMRC any questions about Plastic Packaging Tax if you cannot find an answer in GOV.UK guidance.
You’ll need to sign in to use this form. If you do not already have sign in details, you’ll be able to create them.
Phone
Call HMRC for help with Plastic Packaging Tax, including:
- finding out when you need to register for the tax
- support with your registration
- reporting a change of circumstances
Before you call
This helpline may ask you some security questions. Make sure you have your Plastic Packaging Tax registration number and that your business details are up to date in your business tax account or you could fail telephone security. If you do not have a business tax account, you can create one before you check your details.
Telephone: 0300 200 3700
Textphone: 0300 200 3319
Outside UK: +44 2920 501 261
Opening times: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm. Closed bank holidays.
